verdict.rationale: Devin's embedded IDE and terminal let developers watch live command execution, output logs, and take over the session in real time (devin-docs-6, devin-docs-23, devin-docs-24), plus interactive browser take-over for browsing tasks (devin-docs-7). However, explicit 'status' indicators/progress states are only implied, not documented in detail, and no independent hands-on report confirms the real-time monitoring UX works smoothly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a status/progress indicator UI, independent third-party verification of real-time monitoring experience.
